entities.summary: Masanori Sera is a Japanese singer and actor from Fukuyama. He graduated from Osaka University of Arts. As a singer Sera's rock band, Sera Masanori&TWIST appeared in the Kōhaku Uta Gassen twice. He made his solo debut with the single Tokyo rouge (Tokyo指紅) in 1982. Masanori Sera was a composers & musicians from Fukuyama (b. 1955-12-14, Fukuyama). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
